text: {"pairs":[{"claim_ids":["C001","C007"],"label":"compatible","description":"C001 describes discovery of referral export in a public storage bucket on 4 March 2026 and C007 describes disabling anonymous access the following Monday; the two describe sequential discovery then remediation with no overlapping inconsistent proposition.","severity":"low","passages":["D2.P004","D1.P002"]},{"claim_ids":["C001","C010"],"label":"compatible","description":"C001 describes discovery in a public bucket and C010 describes preservation of the bucket access policy after the audit; different actions at different times with no mutually exclusive claim about the same action or accessibility.","severity":"low","passages":["D2.P004","D6.P001"]},{"claim_ids":["C001","C011"],"label":"contradiction","description":"C001 asserts the referral export was discovered in a public storage bucket, implying public accessibility, while C011 attributes to PERSON_1 PERSON_1's closure memo the claim it was never publicly accessible; both concern the same referral export's accessibility and cannot both be true.","severity":"high","passages":["D2.P004","D7.P005"]},{"claim_ids":["C007","C010"],"label":"compatible","description":"C007 describes disabling anonymous access to the export bucket and C010 describes preserving the bucket access policy after the audit; both are post-discovery handling actions at different times with no inconsistency.","severity":"low","passages":["D1.P002","D6.P001"]},{"claim_ids":["C008","C011"],"label":"compatible","description":"C008 describes changing incident ORG_2 418 from privacy exposure to routine maintenance and C011 describes a closure memo saying the referral export was never publicly accessible; both reflect a consistent recharacterization denying public exposure, not a contradiction.","severity":"low","passages":["D3.P004","D7.P005"]}]}
